sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme aims to promote self-reliance among persons with disabilities through grants, term loans, and margin money assistance.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance; Sector: Banking and money

**Detailed Description:** The "Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Disabled)" scheme was launched by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to empower persons with disabilities by providing financial assistance for sustainable self-employment and livelihood generation. Under this scheme, the beneficiaries are supported with a mix of grants, subsidized loans, and margin money for term loans, shop construction, and bank-linked enterprises.

**Benefits / Assistance:** **Term Loan Scheme:** - Project Cost: ₹75,000/- - Grant: 20% or ₹10,000/-, whichever is less - Term Loan: ₹65,000/- at 6% annual interest rate **Shop Construction Scheme:** - Project Cost: ₹50,000/- - Grant: 20% or ₹10,000/-, whichever is less - Margin Money Loan: ₹40,000/- at 4% annual interest rate, repayable in 60 monthly installments **Margin Money Loan Scheme for Bank Supported Loan:** - Project Cost: Up to ₹2,00,000/- - Grant: 20%, maximum of ₹10,000/- - Margin Money: 25% of the project cost at 4% annual interest rate, repayable in 36 monthly installments

**Application Process:** ***Application Process:*** **Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the [application form](http://www.ukbvvn.org.in/Download/ApplicationFormFormatJeevika.pdf) from the official website. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the office of the Vikas Khand (Block Development) Office. &amp;lt;br&amp;gt; ***Selection Process:*** **Step 1:** The application will be forwarded to the District Social Welfare Officer. **Step 2:** A District-Level Committee, headed by the District Social Welfare Officer, will review the proposals and select beneficiaries.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Department Of Social Welfare
**Tags:** Financial Assistance, Person With Disability, Self-employment, Loan, Margin Money, Shop
